entries.appliesTo: school boards (governing public elementary and secondary schools, school board employees, and school volunteers)

sources.policyRequired: § 22.1-79.3:2(B) — 'Each school board shall prohibit public elementary and secondary schools, school board employees, and school volunteers from using a social media platform as the sole means of communication with students for the facilitation of school-related extracurricular activities.'

flags: No AI provisions: the bill regulates use of social media platforms as a communication channel for school extracurricular activities ('use of social media platforms by schools, school board employees, and volunteers prohibited'); no artificial intelligence content anywhere in the text

Family fit imperfect: education-k12 chosen because the bill binds school boards, but its params (curriculum/training/graduation) target AI-in-schools regimes; only policyRequired applies, and no social-media family exists in the v1.0 vocabulary

Superintendent exception process: § 22.1-79.3:2(C) allows a division superintendent or designee to 'provide a written exception to the prohibition in subsection B' with 'clear, written instructions on such use', revocable at any time — no listed param captures this
Savings clause: 'Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit the use of school division-approved communication or messaging applications' (§ B)
No penalty or enforcement provision in the text — exposure omitted (silence is silence)
